ribs.title: The Ribs
ribs.line: A tidal strait under two rows of rib blades. The tide comes back through the cage as a wall.
details: The drowned, hanging in the weed

heart.title: The Heart
heart.line: A caldera lake of lava under a crust that things walk on. The crust looks like ground.
details: The lava surface at the line
The vessel mouth and its lava fall

breath.title: The Breath
breath.line: A tidal shelf pierced by the airways. The heavy air from the shafts has nothing in it to breathe.

marsh.title: The Blood Marsh
marsh.line: Salt flats where the old blood still seeps up. The mud holds what steps on it.
details: The one on the thin crust

spine.title: The Spine
spine.line: A knife ridge of vertebrae above the cloud. The lightning walks the ridge from spire to spire.
details: The strike on the third spire

eye.title: The Eye
eye.line: A round lake in a socket of cliffs. A ring of amber shallows and a centre that goes all the way down.
details: The edge, where the floor stops
